_comment: Mutants that SURVIVE the suite — the code was broken on purpose and nothing went
red. This file is the DEBT, recorded so that --ci can fail on NEW blindness
without blocking on the existing kind. Shrinking it is the point; adding to it
A key is sha256(path, operator, original, mutated, occurrence)[:16] — deliberately
NOT the line number, so editing elsewhere in the file cannot silently empty the
baseline, and the occurrence index so that N identical lines are N entries rather
than one that pre-waives the other N-1.
MEASURED 2026-08-24 against 60a1b5b + the INCOMPLETE_STOP tests: 318 mutants,
67 survived, 251/318 (79%) caught. An earlier run of this same harness reported
4 survivors / 99% and was WRONG — a full-suite failure unrelated to the mutant
was being scored as a kill, which reports blindness as coverage. `survives()` now
re-runs the pristine copy before attributing any kill and aborts with exit 2 if
the unmutated tree is not green. Treat any sudden jump in the kill rate as this
The entries are labelled 'recorded, not explained' on purpose: that is an honest
statement of what a bulk recording knows. An entry someone has since reasoned
about should have that reasoning written in place of the label.
